description: Publish a site to make changes live. Requires the siteId from list_sites. Builds, packages, uploads, and deploys.

promoteRoutes.description: Routes whose unpublished edits go live in this publish — pages and content entries alike, e.g. ["/", "/about", "/blog/my-post"] (a content entry's route is /<collection>/<slug>). Omit to publish every page and entry with changes. Pass [] to publish only site-wide changes and leave every page and entry draft as it is.

siteId.description: The ID of the site to publish. Get this from list_sites. The tool finds the site's folder on disk itself, so there is nothing else to look up.

name: publish_site
title: Publish site
